Title: Registration with nothing but an email is refused by validation
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` "0"; a message naming the first missing field; no account is created (`name`, `password`, `country`, `device_type` are required)

Title: An email that is already registered is refused
Steps: 1. POST `mobileregistration` with that email, a name, country and device_type, **and no password** (so it can never pass)
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` "0"; the first message says the email is already taken

Title: API registration rejects a malformed email (BT target: match web)
Steps: 1. POST `mobileregistration` with `email=not-an-email`, a name, country, device_type, **no password**
Expected result: the first error is about the email format. **Today the API has no email-format rule**, so the first error is the missing password (known gap KG-P2)
